summary: No code was changed: the assigned test tests/test_imapclient.py::TestRawCommand::test_failed_continuation_wait could not be run because the c0-test hook blocked the call and the jail fell back to fail-closed (no network namespace). Static reading suggests the test sets tagged_commands with the str key "tag" while MockIMAP4._new_tag returns b'tag', so _send_literal's pop would raise KeyError instead of AbortError; no full-suite run was made.
